abstract: Management of acute rheumatic fever requires anti-inflammatory treatment and secondary prophylaxis. In arthritis without severe carditis, aspirin at anti-inflammatory doses 100 mg/kg/day (100 mg/kg/24 giờ) divided in 4 doses for 1 to 2 weeks followed by 75 mg/kg/day (75 mg/kg/24 giờ) for 2 to 4 weeks (2-6 tuần) is effective. For moderate to severe carditis with cardiomegaly or heart failure, prednisolone 1 to 2 mg/kg/day (1-2 mg/kg/24 giờ) for 2 to 3 weeks followed by tapering and aspirin bridging for 6 weeks is recommended.
journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
title: Management of Acute Rheumatic Fever and Rheumatic Heart Disease
